name: The Lady Most Wicked: Side Story 02
source:
Victoria Revelle is your standard reincarnated villainess who must navigate between the lines of mystery, romance, and murder. But her plans for today have come to a halt, since she seems to have come down with a fever...

[From [url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked02]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
维多利亚·雷维尔是一名标准的转生恶役千金，平日里不得不在悬疑、恋爱与谋杀的夹缝间小心周旋。然而她今天的计划却被迫全盘搁浅——因为她似乎发烧病倒了……

[摘自[url=https://fableknot.itch.io/lady-most-wicked02]itch.io[/url]]
